overview_description.description: PerfectBit develops verifier-grounded training data for advanced AI models and research systems. The company focuses on generating information-dense, synthetic, and curated datasets that are designed to be correct by construction. Its data is validated against physics simulators, scientific databases, formal proof systems, and executable tests to reduce errors and hallucinations in downstream models. PerfectBit formats this data across text, code, image, audio, and video modalities for use in large language models, robotics, and AI for scientific applications. Its offering targets teams building frontier models that require high-quality alternatives or supplements to noisy web-scraped text.
